instruction: Configure the desktop background to use the "zoom" picture option instead of other display modes.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing desktop background picture-options to 'zoom' mode via desktop settings. Initial config sets picture-options to 'centered'. Agent must navigate settings and change to zoom. Evaluator verifies picture-options equals 'zoom'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement

Metric (exact_match) correctly compares result against expected value
Expected value "'zoom'\n" is semantically correct (matches gsettings output format with quotes and newline)
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing to 'zoom', evaluator checks exactly that
